name: Agentation
tagline: Turns UI annotations into structured context for coding agents
description: A browser toolbar: click any element, write a note, and it captures the CSS selector, source file path, React component tree and computed styles into markdown a coding agent can act on directly. The MCP integration skips the copy-paste step entirely, so the agent reads annotations straight off the page and can ask follow-up questions about them.
